comp.stanceLabel: 1배수 목표 비중 채움: 다음 카드는 레버리지
commentary: 재료 균형은 긍정 55 대 부정 45: 핵심 재료는 고용보고서 발표 대기.
1배수 칸은 계획한 목표 비중을 채운 상태. 마지막 조정 이후 49거래일째 목표와 현재 비중의 차이가 없어 추가 매수 단계 자체가 없는 구간: 시장 신호가 꺼진 것이 아니라 이 칸에 채울 자리가 없는 것. 다음 자금이 갈 곳은 1배수 추가가 아니라 레버리지 칸: 판단은 아래 레버리지 카드에서.
근거 하나만 들자면: 200일선 위 구간의 20거래일 승률 70%. 추세와 함께 가는 동안은 흔들림을 견디는 쪽이 통계적으로 유리했던 구간.
10월1일(목, 뉴욕) 차트 패턴 '매수'. 반등 신뢰도 체크는 '초기 단계: 확인 관문 남음'(충족 60%). 지표와 같은 방향.
성적 공개: 최근 45번의 방향 판단 중 25번이 5거래일 뒤 방향과 일치(적중률 56%). 이 숫자는 매일 갱신, 악화돼도 그대로 공개.

Not waiting for a "certain bottom": waiting for two defined triggers: a turn up out of oversold (the fear-buying spot) for the first 30% tranche, and a reclaim of the 200-day for the second 30%.

audience.newbie: 신규 진입 대기: 200일선 아래(Gear 1)라 정찰대도 아직. 유효 신호(매수점수 80 이상 극단 과매도) 전이라 통계적 우위도 없는 자리. 여는 조건 둘: 과매도 탈출 반전(1차 30%의 절반으로 시작), 200일선 회복(본대). 그 전까지 현금 유지, 들어가 있다면 직전 저점 이탈 시 철수.

audience.pyramid: 불타기 금지 구간: 하락 추세에서의 추가 매수는 원칙 밖.

audienceEn.holder: Exit criteria worth re-checking: below the 200-day line, trimming exposure is where the data points.
audienceEn.newbie: Waiting zone: below the 200-day line (Gear 1), not even a scout tranche yet. Before the valid signal (extreme oversold with a buy score above 80) fires there is no statistical edge. Two triggers open the door: a turn up out of oversold (start with half of the first 30%) or a reclaim of the 200-day (main tranche).
audienceEn.avgdown: Averaging down is off the table: downtrend confirmed. Lowering your average before a bottom is confirmed has a record of widening losses.
audienceEn.pyramid: Pyramiding is off the table: adding into a downtrend is outside the principles.

nvda.commentaryEn: Today's pre-market (Oct 1): +1.1% ($231), in progress. On NVDA the trend is everything. NVDA splits at its trend line: a 69% win rate over 20 sessions above the 200-day (Gear 3) versus 56% below: trend maintenance is the core of the judgment. The price sits above its 200-day line, so holding is the side of the trade, and the overheating reading (sell pressure 33) has no predictive power here: not a reason on its own to trim.

AAPL.commentaryEn: Today's pre-market (Oct 1): -0.8% ($330), in progress. AAPL is the least signal-sensitive of the nine: neither extreme buy scores nor overheating readings carried a statistical edge. Having little to decide is precisely this stock's character. On today's numbers: buy score 60, sell pressure 17, RSI 51, with the price sitting +14.5% versus its 200-day line. Distance to the next signal: 58 points to the overheating line (sell pressure 75). What would change this call is a single one: the price slipping below its 200-day line. Until then, simply holding has been the favorable side on this stock.

TSM.commentaryEn: Today's pre-market (Oct 1): +0.7% ($459), little changed. True to a semiconductor cycle name, TSM offered the second-largest payoff of the nine for panic buying (RSI below 30, 80% win rate). On today's numbers: buy score 66, sell pressure 43, RSI 66, with the price sitting +19.4% versus its 200-day line. Distance to the next signal: 36 points to the deeply-oversold signal (RSI 30) · 32 points to the overheating line (sell pressure 75). What would change this call is only a deep sell-off (RSI below 30): a wobbling trend has not been much to fear on this particular stock.

Drawdowns have clearly been opportunities here, though scaling in remains the premise.
